scope: Fresh read-only JSON progress/summary/handoff/ledger metadata. No checkpoint tensor loading, model construction, forward, tests, signals, ledger construction, Git or remote mutation.

contract.warmup_distribution: bounded uniform in the shared steering support
contract.stochastic_streams: separate interaction and optimizer generators; paired frozen/online action draws
contract.truncation: bootstrap on time-limit truncation; stop on genuine termination
contract.target_restore: independent complete source restore, then explicit fresh_target replay for primary online fine-tune; source weights/optimizers/costs retained
contract.target_replay: fresh_target samples with replacement from >=1 new target row; no repeated source warmup; carry_source optional diagnostic

limits: Per-method reads are sequential snapshots of actively advancing jobs, not a simultaneous global transaction.
Durable counters come from completed child summaries and hash-bound continuation metadata; checkpoint tensors were not loaded or rehashed in this status audit.
Live pending reservations can represent an active simulator call; they are reported separately from zero-pending durable boundaries.
Target cloned-learner updates are kept separate from source optimizer counters; source collection alone does not imply a PPO update.
Scheduler states were not independently queried; outer exit-code files are reported only if present.
